column1: # Rex app UI preferences (macOS defaults domain com.superlogical.rex).
# deploy.sh --rex writes each row with: defaults write com.superlogical.rex Workspace.<key> -<type> <value>
# These make Rex's chrome match Ghostty's: no sidebar, tabs in the (collapsed) sidebar, no pane headers, compact density, Ghostty-like padding.
# Rex keeps these in its own prefs and rewrites them from Settings, so after changing one in the app, copy it here (defaults read com.superlogical.rex Workspace.<key>).
